description: Hyperscaler and major tenant presence by data center market. Strong existing footprint indicates validated market, ecosystem support (cross-connects, labor, supply chain), and precedent for future expansion. Based on publicly announced and operational facilities as of early 2026.

metrics_explained.hyperscaler_count: Number of hyperscaler operators with active DC presence (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Oracle, Apple).
metrics_explained.hyperscalers_present: List of hyperscalers with known operational or under-construction presence.
metrics_explained.major_colo_operators: Major colocation operators with facilities in the market.
metrics_explained.cloud_on_ramps_available: Number of distinct cloud on-ramp providers (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, Google Cloud Interconnect).
metrics_explained.hyperscaler_tenant_depth_score: Overall tenant ecosystem strength. 1=strong (deep, multi-hyperscaler), 5=thin (limited operators).

Northern Virginia.notes: Deepest ecosystem globally. Every major hyperscaler and colo present.

Dallas-Fort Worth.notes: Strong second-tier ecosystem. All major hyperscalers except Apple have significant Dallas presence.

Silicon Valley.notes: HQ presence for most hyperscalers. Strong but capacity-constrained.

Phoenix.notes: Growing quickly. Apple iCloud anchor in Mesa. AWS and Microsoft major investments.

Chicago.notes: Mature market with strong enterprise tenant depth.

Atlanta.notes: Expanding rapidly. Meta and Google recent expansions.

New York/New Jersey.notes: Financial services tenant depth. Limited greenfield hyperscaler growth.

Columbus.notes: Fastest-growing hyperscaler cluster. Intel investment magnifies ecosystem.

Hillsboro-Portland.notes: Prineville is Meta/Apple anchor. The Dalles is Google. Hillsboro serves hyperscalers.

Reno-Sparks.notes: Apple Project McQueen anchor. Switch's SUPERNAP is major colo.

Salt Lake City.notes: Meta Eagle Mountain campus. Growing Microsoft presence.

Austin-San Antonio.notes: Microsoft San Antonio campus. Growing AI-focused facilities.

Kansas City.notes: Meta Kansas City campus anchor. Limited but growing.

Denver.notes: Strong colo presence, limited hyperscaler depth.

Richmond.notes: Meta Henrico campus. Growing as NoVA overflow.

default_for_non_market.notes: Non-DC market with limited operator presence. Ecosystem support limited.
